manifest.name: dsh-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team (upstream), local fork maintained by mengzhongjie
manifest.description: dsh-superagent 的本地改造版，作为 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）bundle：需求来自本机操作者的主会话而不是 GitHub/飞书，每个工作区各有一条主会话，主会话只负责路由，真正的活儿派给 Worker 在该工作区目录里执行。

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins without configuration, and the agent presets its Sessions run under. The
# profile supplies the `dsh-superagent` entry's stateDir (see docs/006-deployment.md and examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml); the plugin
# refuses to start without stateDir.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # 飞书 IM 来源：群消息与私聊进工单。没有配置机器人 CLI 时它自己报「未设置机器人 CLI」，
    # 不影响别的来源，所以默认开着，让人能直接在设置里填。
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
    # 本地 Source：把操作者在主会话里说的话当作需求来源；一个实例覆盖所有工作区。
    - id: dsh-superagent-dsh
      name: dsh-superagent/local-watch
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 执行器
        description: dsh-superagent 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 主 Session
        description: dsh-superagent 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令和任务等待超 5 秒转入后台，只含路由所需的工具。
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              # The main Session routes; it must not carry work out itself. Without a shell tool it
              # cannot write files (fs writes are already off), so a request can only become a ticket.
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: true
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: true
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

readme.section: This fork: work from your own machine
readme.text:
This repository is a fork of [dsh-superagent](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent) that serves
**the person sitting at the machine** instead of a GitHub repository. Four things differ from upstream:

readme.section: This fork: work from your own machine
readme.text:
- **A local Source.** `src/sources/dsh.ts` (exported as `./local-watch`) turns a message in the main
  Session into a Trigger, and sends the answer back to that same Session. `source.kind === 'user'` is
  the filter, so messages that the orchestrator injects itself never loop back in.
- **One main Session per workspace.** Every sidebar workspace has its own orchestrator, created on
  demand and remembered in `KV.runtime.masters` (workspaceId to sessionId). `GET
  /orchestrator/api/master?workspace=<id>` returns it, creating it when missing.
- **A sidebar entry.** The client half injects a star button into each workspace group row
  (`[data-row-key^="workspace:"]`), opens that workspace's main Session, and hides main-session rows
  from the list.
- **Attachments.** Images and files travel with the request: the Trigger carries
  `meta.attachments`, and the Worker receives the attachment-store path so it can open the file
  before deciding anything.

readme.section: This fork: work from your own machine
readme.text:
It also runs without GitHub: `resolveDeployment` returns an empty repository when no remote is
configured, and the GitHub watcher reports `paused` instead of polling.

When an operator asks for work, the main Session routes it into a Ticket and a Worker does it in that
workspace's directory; the main Session never edits files itself.

readme.section: This fork: work from your own machine
readme.text: It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

This bundle is not published to npm. Install it from the repository or from a prebuilt tarball:

```sh

readme.section: from source: the `prepare` script builds lib/ during install
or a prebuilt tarball from the latest release
readme.text:
dsh plugin add https://github.com/mengzhongjie/dsh-superagent-local/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-superagent-0.2.1.tgz
```

Then follow [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) for the profile configuration and the first start.

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build. `pnpm pack` produces the installable
bundle used by `dsh plugin add`. A fresh clone has no `lib/` (it is built, not committed); the
`prepare` script builds it, so `pnpm install` is enough before starting the harness from source.
